name: 4DUser SEO
author: mlemos

sections.description:
Currently, this plugin can:

  • Make 404 pages return HTTP status 200 and have the tag to hint search engines like Google, Bing, Yahoo, Yandex, and others to remove from the search index right after the pages are crawled.
sections.installation: Install this plugin from the WordPress plugins panel.
sections.faq:
1. How can I disable the feature that removes from the search engine\’s index 404 pages?
  • Go to the WordPress administration panel
  • Click on the Settings menu
  • Click on the 4DUser Plugin Menu
  • Uncheck the option Remove from search engines\’ index pages that do not exist
  • Click on the Save button

short_description: This plugin helps site administrators solve search engine issues like removing faster from Google index pages that were infected by malware.
